# `aitbc governance execute`

Execute a governance proposal on-chain as a governance executor (the vote tally is advisory and does not decide execution; V-7).

## Usage

```bash
aitbc governance execute [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--proposal-id` | text | — | yes | The Proposal id. |
| `--executor-address` | text | — | no | Executor wallet address (for on-chain execution) |
| `--wallet` | text | — | no | Wallet to sign the on-chain GOVERNANCE_EXECUTE tx (client-signed submission) |
| `--password-stdin` | flag | `false` | no | Read the wallet password from one line of standard input |
| `--password-file` | file | — | no | Path to a file containing only the wallet password (mode 0600, owned by you) |
| `--password` | text | — | no | Wallet password (deprecated: visible in process lists and shell history; prefer --password-stdin or --password-file) |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc governance execute --proposal-id <proposal_id>
```
